t: A successor state of the Golden Horde founded c. 1441 by Haci I Giray, a descendant of Genghis Khan.
From 1475 an Ottoman vassal and ally, its cavalry raids on Poland-Lithuania and Muscovy fed the slave market of Caffa.
Russian victories made it a nominally independent protectorate in 1774, and Catherine II annexed it in 1783.
dyk: Muscovy kept paying the Crimean khans regular ‘gifts’, in effect tribute, until the Treaty of Constantinople in 1700, long after the Golden Horde had vanished.
ev: Haci I Giray establishes an independent khanate in the Crimea
Ottomans conquer Caffa; Mengli I Giray later accepts Ottoman suzerainty
Mengli Giray destroys the Great Horde
Islam III Giray allies with Bohdan Khmelnytsky against Poland-Lithuania
A Russian army under Münnich burns Bakhchysarai
Treaty of Kuchuk Kainarji ends Ottoman suzerainty
Catherine II annexes the Crimea to the Russian Empire
